title: NavigationStatus
description: Where a NavigationAgentComponent stands. - `idle` - no destination; the state before the first command and after NavigationAgentComponent.stop. - `navigating` - following a route, including a partial one that a search budget cut short. - `arrived` - within `arrivalDistance` of the destination. A followed target that moves away puts it back to `navigating`. - `unreachable` - no route leads to the destination, the search budget is too small to get past its own node, or it has reached the closest point a `snapToNearest` search could offer. - `blocked` - a route exists, but the movement made no progress along it even after a fresh search. `unreachable` and `blocked` are retried on their own when the space's revision changes or a followed target moves to another node; `blocked` is also retried after four repath intervals, since what stopped the actor - such as another actor - may have moved on without any revision changing.

paragraphs: - `idle` - no destination; the state before the first command and after NavigationAgentComponent.stop. - `navigating` - following a route, including a partial one that a search budget cut short. - `arrived` - within `arrivalDistance` of the destination. A followed target that moves away puts it back to `navigating`. - `unreachable` - no route leads to the destination, the search budget is too small to get past its own node, or it has reached the closest point a `snapToNearest` search could offer. - `blocked` - a route exists, but the movement made no progress along it even after a fresh search.

`unreachable` and `blocked` are retried on their own when the space's revision changes or a followed target moves to another node; `blocked` is also retried after four repath intervals, since what stopped the actor - such as another actor - may have moved on without any revision changing.
